title: Canonical comparison of supplied qcqs etale limit presentations
statement: Let I and J be small nonempty cofiltered categories, D : I → Scheme and D' : J → Scheme diagrams of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-size-convention] and [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let P and P' be any supplied Presentations of D and D', r : J → I an initial functor, and epsilon : D' ≅ r ⋙ D an isomorphism of scheme diagrams. Then there exists a Comparison c of their projection cones over r and epsilon such that c.IsCanonical [def-per-qcqs-etale-limit-presentation]: the underlying sheaf categories are equivalent with the specified pullback-pasting-compatible projection comparisons, and comparison with any other such datum is by a unique invertible natural transformation respecting every projection. Neither presentation is constructed by this statement.

source.place: Tags 09YL and 0A35; ILO XX 4.4, printed p.373 (literature/illusie-laszlo-orgogozo-travaux-de-gabber_arXiv-1207.3648.pdf, PDF p.379).

proof.text: For cofinal reindexing use the filtered opposite functor, final in the convention of [lem-per-filtered-category-pseudococones]. That lemma gives an equivalence of colimit categories. A reindexed stage cover is an original stage cover; conversely any original stage has an arrow to a reindexed stage, so its covers transport there. Thus the equivalence identifies the generated topologies. Apply [lem-pc-fppf-dense-sheaf-equivalence] to obtain the equivalence of sheaf topoi. Compatible isomorphisms of scheme diagrams give objectwise site equivalences by Step 1, so the same argument applies by the last clause of [lem-per-filtered-category-pseudococones]. On each stage the site functors commute up to their specified comparisons; uniqueness in [lem-per-lex-cover-functor-extension] identifies projection inverse images and all coherence maps. This also compares two strictifications of the same diagram.

lean.statement:
theorem presentation_comparison
    {I J : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [SmallCategory J]
    [IsCofiltered I] [IsCofiltered J]
    {D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}} {D' : J ⥤ Scheme.{u}}
    [∀ i : I, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ j : J, CompactSpace (D'.obj j)] [∀ j : J, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D'.obj j)]
    (P : Presentation D) (P' : Presentation D') (r : J ⥤ I) [r.Initial]
    (ε : D' ≅ r ⋙ D) :
    ∃ c : Comparison P.projections P'.projections r ε, c.IsCanonical

split_report.summary: A strictly smaller component of the existing seven-step argument, with its original generic inputs retained. No chapter or unit route is replaced.
split_report.edge_cases: Cofiltered means nonempty; empty schemes are allowed, with empty covering families and potentially empty conservative point family. Identity reindexing compares arbitrary strictifications. Scheme isomorphisms preserve qcqs. No affine-transition or limit-scheme hypothesis is introduced.
